first_prompt: The following is the Codex agent history added since your last approval assessment. Continue the same review conversation. Treat the transcript delta, tool call arguments, tool results, retry reason,

commits.summary: Pin six organic Java repairs and run their original upstream tests (verification pending)
commits.body:
Record six landed changes with their genuine first parents and the common verifier baseline 5e41cd71. Build the owning module on JDK 21, bind the exact class to its ordered dependency closure, and transplant only the landed test sources onto the parent. Each named Surefire testcase must execute and show the expected old and new dispositions.

Verified all twelve source identities, all eight named test methods and their absence on the parents, the Maven recipe schemas and the queue. The changed selection passed all 58 Rust test binaries. Jobs 20261121-090451-353-build-both-original-modules-and-exec through 20261121-090452-358-build-both-original-modules-and-exec archive the two original builds and the named test results for each PR.

commits.summary: Freeze six original Java PR contracts and measure the common baseline (verification pending)
commits.body:
Register examples 353–358 with independent UTF-16, count, buffer, parser and byte-stream oracles. The six tables contain 49, 1515, 21, 13, 9 and 2051 inputs. Seventeen deliberately wrong observations are rejected. Every claim uses a public production call and separate parent and fix obligations. Pin the actual native executable and 224 source files at 5e41cd71 before changing the engine.

Collected all six upstream jobs with matching job specifications and output hashes. Four original projects built on both revisions, their exact landed tests failed before and passed after, and their independent public replays qualified. The remaining builds recorded the requested Guava and Avro toolchains. The checked replacement configuration binds Temurin 26 for the Guava compiler and 11, 17 and 21 for Avro. Jobs 20261121-091854-353-toolchains-build-with-the-declared-m and 20261121-091854-355-toolchains-build-with-the-declared-m repeat them. Eight native and finite baseline jobs for 354, 356, 357 and 358 were submitted at 09:18:54–55 UTC.

VF-052 came from a duplicate archived H2 calibration receipt reintroduced during integration. Verified all 14 archived file digests and restored the prior active directory. The four available forms and ordinary replays passed, all 52 tasks planned, queue validation passed, and the changed suite passed all 43 groups after repeating acceptance against the corrected tree.

commits.summary: Record the first four native and finite baselines and recover the original reactors (verification pending)
commits.body:
All 26 finite obligations on Commons Lang, both Gson changes and Commons Codec reached their expected disposition. Seven native obligations did so. The original scanner already classifies the overflowing decimal, while two distinct Gson call paths stop when a char-array slice constructs a String. The complete native and finite attempts, including each first refusal, come from the same executable and 224-file product fingerprint.

The original Guava JRE module and all 49 public multiset rows now replay on both commits. A capped unchanged-baseline probe proved fixed lookup across all 49 operand pairs. Guava testlib needs the installed multi-release JAR for its Java 9 descriptor. The Avro mapred reactor needs packaged sibling test JARs, its declared provided Hadoop classpath, and a Unix login in the isolated guest. Jobs 20261121-093137-353-baseline-native-checks-on-the-origin and 20261121-093137-353-baseline-finite-checks-on-the-origin cover Guava, 20261121-093202-353-build-guava-testlib-build-with-the-d repeats its two named original tests, and 20261121-092910-355-build-avro-mapred-build-with-the-dec binds and checks the Avro pair.

Matched collected job specifications and all applied artifact digests. Confirmed all 17 wrong-observation controls and five prepared example forms. The changed suite passed 36 of 37 groups before the Guava replay required regenerating the router. Its failed discovery assertion passed after regeneration. The full suite, including the VF-052 receipt integrity check, passed all 66 groups on the preceding corpus during development.

commits.summary: Prove UTF-16 array slices and code-point reads on original Java callers (verification pending)
commits.body:
The native checker now snapshots exactly the requested char-array range into a distinct String. It preserves isolated UTF-16 units, checks offset and count without overflow, and retains the original null and bounds exceptions. String.codePointAt handles a valid pair, isolated surrogates and invalid indices. Character tests and charCount execute from the selected JDK image.

Capped strict-native probes now establish the complete Gson number text on its original reader, the second BOM on the other Gson reader after short reads, and all 36 windows on a fixed mixed Commons Lang string. Each previously stopped in the same source-level claims. The full 1515-window symbolic Lang proof still hit its 60-second budget. Jobs 20261121-094513-354-utf16-native-checks-on-the-original, 20261121-094513-356-utf16-native-checks-on-the-original and 20261121-094513-357-utf16-native-checks-on-the-original run the registered tasks. Jobs 20261121-095047-354-cover-the-original-utf-16-truncation and 20261121-095059-354-fixed-commons-lang-truncation-over-a check the full grid by bytecode-validated native specialization.

Both fresh Guava builds now run the two real JRE regression tests and reproduce the same JARs. The frozen baseline already decided all ten Guava obligations, including the real iterator, its exhaustion and live mutation. Avro must install its top-level snapshot parent for a second Maven resolution and disable its build cache when running the landed named test. Job 20261121-094727-355-build-avro-root-build-with-the-decla repeats those steps and checks Avro through the original fingerprinted Git workflow and binary. The full values conformance suite passed on JVM, interpreter and checker, including symbolic snapshot, overflow, invalid ranges, null precedence and a replayed wrong code-point result. All 37 changed test groups passed.

commits.summary: Execute the real JDK output sink across partitioned Java writes (verification pending)
commits.body:
The native checker and concrete interpreter now execute OutputStream, FilterOutputStream, ByteArrayOutputStream and the JDK array-growth helpers from the selected image. The caller can reuse the same array at changing offsets, read a copy of the sink, grow it, close the wrapper, and reset it without changing an earlier snapshot.

A direct JDK control passed both offsets, tested growth and reset, and refuted a deliberately aliased snapshot. It also passed in the interpreter and native checker. Both the original ten-character Commons Codec repair and its full 2048 input-and-partition grid were established in strict native probes where the baseline stopped at the sink constructor. The changed Rust selection passed all 58 test binaries. Job 20261121-095939-358-streams-native-checks-on-the-origina records all six original parent, fix and preservation obligations.

commits.summary: Verify ordered upstream class providers on the original subject JVM (verification pending)
commits.body:
Both complete Avro builds and their historical regression now reproduce on the declared Hadoop 3.4.3 host. The baseline refused seven package-info duplicates among the 124 original JARs. Upstream preparations can now explicitly declare individual duplicate dependency classes, including package metadata. Every original contender and SHA is retained, and an independent subject JVM must load the first provider with exactly those bytes. Shadowing the original application or adapter is still rejected.

All six original public replays now match the fixed-side oracle. With a five-byte Hadoop backing array and logical length three, Avro moved the limit from five to three, retained capacity five, and changed the first out-of-prefix read from byte four to IndexOutOfBoundsException. Absolute prefix reads preserved position zero. The original native factory reaches Configuration startup and the standalone nested converter reaches Schema startup. The separate initializer probes refused an environment read and a CPU-count-dependent Jackson initialization. Jobs 20261121-100724-355-ordered-native-checks-on-the-origina and 20261121-100725-355-ordered-finite-checks-on-the-origina repeat all ten Avro obligations.

Both Gson PRs and every control now qualify in strict native checking. On Commons Lang the direct fixed-grid proof timed out. The checked specializations established all 1515 original windows and replayed a parent counterexample. The Codec parent, fix and controls passed on all 2048 short partitions and three long schedules. The qualified native total is five of six main PRs. Live Avro lookup checked seven class origins on each original JDK 21 classpath. A synthetic upstream build checked both distinct package bytes and refusal of original-target shadowing, all 31 upstream runtime tests passed, and the changed selection passed all 46 groups.

Open the two conditional transfers outside the primary totals. Guava already preserves its entry through nested iterator frames, while the sequential reads and writes in Gson and Codec preserve content across calls. Jobs 20261121-101427-359-build-reserve-build-with-the-declare and 20261121-101427-360-build-reserve-build-with-the-declare package each real Eclipse Collections and JavaParser revision and run the upstream test.

commits.summary: Preserve the selected JDK's String exception order and register the two transfer cases (verification pending)
commits.body:
A null array and a negative offset or count can have two different Java exceptions. Both native engines now consult the selected bootstrap constructor, including the exception's own bytecode in Java 8. A check without runtime bytes refuses the ambiguous case. Five real JVMs and five strict native probes agreed: Java 8 reported bounds, bounds, null while Java 11, 17, 21 and 25 reported null three times. All 18 values tests and the 43 changed-test suites passed.

Freeze two separate transfer cases: Eclipse Collections' 2,865 bounded insertions and JavaParser's two traversal shapes with identity and exhaustion controls. Historical build jobs 20261121-102122-359 and 20261121-102122-360 replace the first attempts, which reached the unrelated Eclipse P2 plugin and the incompatible Java 21 SequencedCollection API respectively. Their JDK 17 builds supply original JARs for JDK 21 observations. Jobs starting 20261121-102303 through 20261121-102305 repeat all primary native and finite checks and both Lang selector proofs on this tree.

Recount actual test XML and original bytecode receipts, including Surefire's named assertion source lines when malformed UTF-16 truncates its XML stack message. The ordered Hadoop run finished all ten finite obligations and reached real external initialization in both strict routes. The scorecard independently reconstructed 36 of 46 native and 46 of 46 finite outcomes ahead of the final repeat.
